info.description: A registered Rutba-MTA sender: the from-address campaigns send as, plus the trust token and webhook secret the MTA issues once at registration. The RMAILX 'mail agent' equivalent.

webhook_url.description: Where the MTA posts delivery events. Defaults to <STRAPI_PUBLIC_URL>/api/cmp/webhook when left blank at bootstrap.

smtp_host.description: Echo of the SMTP relay registered with the MTA, for display only.

mta_sender_id.description: Sender uuid returned by POST /v1/senders. Empty until bootstrapped.

trust_token.description: X-Trust-Token for this sender. Returned once by the MTA and unrecoverable — rotate to replace. Stored `private` so it is stripped on serialize, matching marketplace-account credential handling; the column itself is not encrypted at rest.

webhook_secret.description: HMAC secret used to verify X-Mailer-Signature on inbound delivery webhooks. Same storage caveat as trust_token.

last_verified_at.description: Last successful GET /v1/senders/me against the MTA.
